greeting: Hello! Welcome to our AI Customer Support Service. How can I help you today?

order_status.response: For order tracking or status updates, please provide your order or reference ID. I can help you understand the current support process.

order_cancel.response: Orders may be cancelled depending on their current processing status. Please provide your order or reference ID so we can assist you.

delivery.response: Delivery information can depend on the service and location. For an existing order, please provide your order or reference ID so we can assist you with delivery-related questions.

returns.response: Return support is available for eligible products or services. Please provide your order or reference ID and explain the reason for the return.

refunds.response: Refund processing time can vary depending on the transaction and approval status. Please provide your order, reference, or transaction details for further assistance.

payments.response: We can assist with payment methods, failed payments, transaction issues, and payment-related questions. Please provide the relevant transaction details when requesting assistance.

account.response: For account assistance, please explain the problem you are facing, such as login, profile, registered email, or account-access issues.

password.response: You can usually reset your password using the Forgot Password option on the login page. If you continue to experience problems, contact customer support for further assistance.

products.response: I can provide general assistance with product information, features, specifications, availability, and related questions. Please tell me which product or feature you are interested in.

services.response: Our customer support service can help with product and service enquiries, account assistance, transactions, technical issues, and general customer questions.

pricing.response: For pricing, charges, fees, or cost-related questions, please provide the name of the product or service you are asking about.

subscription.response: Subscription support can include information about plans, renewals, membership, billing, and cancellation. Please describe what you need help with.

technical.response: I can help with common technical issues such as errors, setup, installation, configuration, software problems, and troubleshooting. Please describe the problem you are experiencing.

connectivity.response: For connectivity problems involving internet, Wi-Fi, network access, or offline issues, please describe the problem and any error message you received.

complaint.response: We are sorry to hear that you experienced a problem. Please describe your complaint clearly so it can be reviewed and appropriate support can be provided.

feedback.response: Thank you for your feedback. Please share your suggestion, review, or experience so it can be recorded and considered.

contact.response: Customer support can assist with general enquiries, account issues, service questions, technical problems, and other customer concerns. Support availability may depend on the service.

escalation.response: If your issue requires additional assistance, you can request escalation to a customer-support representative or supervisor. Please describe the issue and provide any relevant reference details.

general.response: I can help with general enquiries, products, services, orders, delivery, returns, refunds, payments, accounts, subscriptions, technical issues, connectivity, complaints, feedback, and customer support.
